status: written AFTER exploratory probes (declared): gaussian A=0.25 w=3 alpha=0.1 (N=800/1600/3200) and chi-star s=1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0 alpha=0.1 (N=1600; s=2.0 also N=800/3200). Probe outcome seen: horizon, QT-saturated centre that bounces and is recompressed, kinetic-dominated. The criteria below were fixed before running this bank; a --quick smoke run (3 configs, alpha = 0.1) was used only to fix the centre-density estimator and the trust tolerance (declared).
code: dn/solver.py: diamond scheme, regular centre, psi from generalized mass, causal masking (failed nodes -> NaN, only their causal future is lost)

families.star: phi(u=0, r) = sqrt2 * s * phi_star(r), C59a ground state (phi0 = 0.12), tapered tail; s in {1.75, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0}
families.tophat: A / (1 + exp((r - R)/0.5)), A = 0.3, R in {3, 4, 6} (closest analogue of the homogeneous patch)

trust: centre trusted while |phi_c(N=1600) - phi_c(3200)| < 0.02 and |delta rho_c| < 0.05 max(rho_c) (rho_c intrinsic: phi_v = (1/2) d phi_c/du on the centre line) (same u); events are evaluated on the N = 3200 centre history up to that time only. 2D trusted mask (dn/convergence.py) reported for information

events.B: centre QT bounce: comoving H_c changes sign - to + while alpha psi_c >= 0.9
events.L: launch: an interval of centre proper time >= 1/H_inf during which kinetic fraction < 0.5, rho_c < 10 V0, H_c > 0 and |phi_c| > CHI_END hold continuously (with or without B; L_after_B recorded separately)
events.R: recompression after B: rho_c exceeds 10x its post-bounce minimum
events.MI: inner-horizon diagnostic: max interior (r < 2) generalized mass / M_ADM, over the 2D trusted mask (N = 1600 vs 3200) and, for information, over all finite nodes

verdict.PASS: L in at least one run with H, for each alpha, in the star family
verdict.FAIL: no L in any run with H, and every run with H and B shows R inside the trusted domain
verdict.note: the specification's PASS (lambda in the C54 window, e-folds within 10 % of C45) can only be evaluated if L occurs; then the trusted centre state is continued with the homogeneous model
